description: Permanently and IRREVERSIBLY hard-delete an entity from the recycle bin. The entity and all its children are removed from the database — this cannot be undone. Requires Admin role. Call once with no token to preview; re-call with the returned confirm_token and an idempotency_key to commit. entity_type must be one of: Customer, Project, Task, SubTask. Refused (CONFLICT.STATE_CONFLICT) when the entity is not in the recycle bin (reason NOT_IN_RECYCLE_BIN) or when anything under it is live - restored, or never deleted (reason LIVE_DESCENDANTS).

confirm_token.description: Token returned by the preview (call this tool once with no token to get it). Required to commit; expires in ~10 minutes.

entity_id.description: Id of the recycle-bin entity to permanently delete.

entity_type.description: Type of entity to permanently delete. One of: Customer, Project, Task, SubTask.

idempotency_key.description: Required when committing (confirm_token present): retrying with the same key returns the original result instead of acting twice.

name: permanent_delete_entity
title: Permanently delete (irreversible)
